name: raily-matches
description: Raily is a personal AI agent that finds people worth meeting for you (friends, dates, business contacts) and handles the first contact. This mod shows your Raily inbox above the Claude Code prompt: new matches with name, city and score, contact requests, unread chats and questions from your agent, with a toast for each new event. Read-only. Needs a Raily account (18+) and the Raily MCP server connected.
